name: submit_data
description: Submit the finished data definition for the widget. Call it once the query has been tested with run_query and returns exactly the brief's figures. The submission is checked automatically (schema, parameters, units and formats, a live run with the sample parameters, catalog references); if anything fails you get the reasons back - fix them and submit again.

params.description: The parameters the query uses as $name, e.g. clientId (string). $asOfDate is built in: you may declare it (type date) or not.

name.description: clientId (or another page parameter), or asOfDate

cypher.description: A read-only Cypher query (MATCH ... RETURN; no CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE or CALL ... IN TRANSACTIONS). Use parameters for every value: $clientId for the selected client, $asOfDate for the data's today (ISO text: compare with datetime($asOfDate)). Never literal client ids or dates, never date() or datetime() with no argument. Each RETURN alias is a result column.

columns.description: Every column each result row has (the RETURN aliases), in display order.

unit.description: USD for money; ratio for a 0-1 fraction; percent for a value already 0-100; count; date; none.

format.description: Must agree with unit: USD->currency, ratio->percent, percent->percentPoints, count->integer, date->date.

measures.description: One entry per numeric column: how it is defined and where the definition comes from.

definition.description: Plain-language definition as computed by the query.

catalogReference.description: Label.property or Label.derivedMetricName from the data dictionary that this figure is based on, e.g. Holding.drawnUsd or Client.utilization.

expectedShape.description: What the rows should look like, e.g. 'one row per quarter, 8 rows, ascending'.

emptyIsExpected.description: true only if an empty result is a legitimate outcome for some clients (e.g. a client with no covenants) and the sample happened to be empty.

assumptions.description: Data-level choices the banker should know about (e.g. 'counts only open deals').
